req.title: Return 404 for unknown routes
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 for any path not matching a defined route.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-036 requires that any path not matching a defined route returns HTTP 404. The two violations are: test[0] has kind=negative but heuristic=EP (EP must be positive kind), and test[6] has kind=negative but heuristic=EP (same violation). Fix: change both to kind=positive since EP tests exercise the normal/expected equivalence partition — in this case the expected outcome IS 404 for unknown paths, making it a positive test of the error pathway. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_unknown_path_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /this-route-does-not-exist is not registered in httpbin
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /this-route-does-not-exist
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 404
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: system shall respond with HTTP 404 for any path not matching a defined route
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/this-route-does-not-exist')
assert r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_known_route_get_returns_200_not_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /get is a registered route in httpbin
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /get (a known valid route)
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: defined routes must NOT return 404; only undefined routes should
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/get')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert r.status_code != 404

tests.name: test_near_miss_path_one_char_off_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /gets is not a registered route (one char beyond /get)
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /gets (one character beyond the known /get route)
Send GET request to /ge (one character before the known /get route)
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 404 for /gets
HTTP response status code is exactly 404 for /ge
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: paths that are one character off from a defined route are still undefined and must return 404
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/gets')
assert r.status_code == 404
r2 = client.get('/ge')
assert r2.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_unknown_path_with_post_returns_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /nonexistent-endpoint is not registered for any HTTP method
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send POST request to /nonexistent-endpoint
Send PUT request to /nonexistent-endpoint
Send DELETE request to /nonexistent-endpoint
expected: All responses return HTTP status code exactly 404 regardless of HTTP method
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: any path not matching a defined route returns 404 for all HTTP methods
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r_post = client.post('/nonexistent-endpoint')
assert r_post.status_code == 404
r_put = client.put('/nonexistent-endpoint')
assert r_put.status_code == 404
r_delete = client.delete('/nonexistent-endpoint')
assert r_delete.status_code == 404

preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process

tests.name: test_known_headers_route_returns_200_not_404
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path /headers is a registered GET route in httpbin
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Send GET request to /headers
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-036: /headers is a defined route and must not return 404
